items.name: DEXI® Audit
items.description: Strategic commercial audit that identifies why customers hesitate, lose trust, or choose a competitor, then pinpoints the highest-impact barrier and delivers a prioritized roadmap to improve conversion, e-commerce, UX, customer journey and growth.

items.name: Commercial Transformation
items.description: End-to-end commercial transformation for businesses that need more customers to choose, buy, return and refer. We identify the decision barriers holding back growth, then redesign the strategy, positioning, digital experience, e-commerce and customer journey around what will change the outcome.

items.name: Growth Strategy
items.description: Commercial growth strategy built around the customer decision. We identify the strongest opportunities to increase demand, conversion, retention and referrals, then define the priorities, initiatives and roadmap required to turn those opportunities into measurable growth.

items.name: Digital Strategy
items.description: Digital strategy for businesses that need a more effective path from attention to conversion. We align website, content, customer journey, digital channels and commercial priorities around how customers discover, evaluate, trust and choose the business.

items.name: E-commerce Strategy
items.description: E-commerce strategy for consumer and DTC brands focused on improving product discovery, perceived value, trust, conversion and repeat purchase. We identify where customers hesitate or leave, then reshape the shopping experience around the buying decision.

items.name: UX & Conversion Optimization
items.description: UX and conversion optimization focused on the points that influence customer choice. We improve navigation, page structure, messaging, calls to action, trust signals, mobile experience and purchase flow to reduce friction and increase conversion.

items.name: Customer Journey Strategy
items.description: Customer journey strategy that maps how people discover, evaluate, choose, buy, return and recommend. We identify the moments where interest, trust or momentum is lost, then redesign the journey to create a clearer path toward conversion and long-term value.

items.name: Positioning Strategy
items.description: Positioning strategy that clarifies why a customer should choose your business over the alternatives. We define the value, competitive frame, proof, messaging and decision triggers needed to make the offer easier to understand, trust and choose.

items.name: Brand & Creative Direction
items.description: Brand and creative direction built around customer perception and commercial goals. We shape the visual language, photography, messaging, product presentation and creative system to strengthen desirability, distinction, trust and the reasons customers choose the brand.

items.name: Content & PR Strategy
items.description: Content and PR strategy designed to build authority, visibility and trust around the business. We define the stories, editorial angles, proof points, media opportunities and content system that help customers understand the brand and feel more confident choosing it. Retention & Referral Strategy

items.name: Retention & Referral Strategy
items.description: Retention and referral strategy focused on turning a first purchase into a longer customer relationship. We identify the right follow-up, loyalty, repeat-purchase and recommendation mechanics to increase return behavior, customer value and qualified referrals.

items.name: AI & Automation Consulting
items.description: AI and automation consulting for businesses looking to improve customer experience, marketing operations and internal efficiency. We identify practical opportunities for research, personalization, content, workflows and automation, then define what is worth implementing and why.
